name: QRX API
description: Codes are made asynchronously: creating one answers at once with its id and the status `processing`, and the code usually succeeds in under a minute. Poll it, or pass `?wait=45` to hold the request open until it finishes. Every code counts against the account’s plan exactly as codes made in the app do.
